run_exact_match_diff_metric: run ExactMatchDiffMetric.evaluate to score predictions against targets using diff overlap
run_exact_match_metric: run ExactMatchMetric.evaluate to compute the fraction of predictions matching any target
run_insert_delete_metric: run InsertDeleteMetric.evaluate to score insertions and deletions using n-gram overlap
run_easse_sari_metric: run EasseSariMetric.evaluate to compute SARI scores for sentence editing predictions
run_ibleu_metric: run iBLEUMetric.evaluate to compute iBLEU scores balancing reference BLEU and input BLEU
